items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: He had a Grodin style though, wasn't it?

ctx.x: What style did he play? Emett Hardy. Yeah, Emmett Hardy. What style did he play? Emett Hardy. Yeah, Emmett Hardy. Just like for anybody else. Did he play like a... Just like for anybody else. A Joloba style? No, just anybody.
Poor Emmett didn't last for one. He wasn't going. Like Charlie? Same way, he just had good rhythm. Sorta like that. He had a Grodin style though, wasn't it? That's all. That's all.
It wasn't a Big Spiderback style, was it? No, Big Spiderback, no.
